name: iact_hyades_magic_lst1_giants
label: The four Hyades giants on MAGIC-I + MAGIC-II + LST-1 at 425 nm with the real NewEra giant models (log g 2.5): diameters beyond the first null and the gravity / metallicity profile tests
notes: CHARA (Boyajian et al. 2009, K' band) measured theta_LD = 2.517 / 2.408 / 2.733 / 2.305 mas for gamma / delta1 / epsilon / theta1 Tau to 1.3-1.9 %. At 425 nm their first nulls lie at 39-46 m: every MAGIC + LST-1 baseline (43-107 m projected) is past the null, in the second and third lobes (|V|^2 < 0.02), except the short end of MAGIC-II-LST-1 which crosses the null itself.

Real giant models from the 2026-11-01 NewEra cool-giant box: each target's own atmosphere.model (epsilon Tau lte04900-2.50-0.0; gamma, delta1, theta1 Tau lte04800-2.50-0.0; no campaign-wide stand_in). compare_models brackets the gravity (log g 2.0 and 3.0 at 4800 K), the metallicity (4900 K / 2.5 at +0.5), and repeats the 2026-10 stand-ins (5000 K dwarf and supergiant) so the old bracket can be compared with the real profile.
Companion of iact_hyades_magic_lst1 (the 2026-10-28 stand-in run); docs/hyades_ld.md compares the two.
